customer_message.subject: Black mould in my flat at Weiherweg 56, Schaffhausen - request for advice
customer_message.body: Dear Legal Expenses Team, I am writing to ask for help with a defect in my rented 4-room flat at Weiherweg 56, Schaffhausen. My landlord is Peter Ammann, a private landlord. There is black mould spreading on the bedroom wall and around the bathroom window. I first reported this to Mr. Ammann in writing on 19 June 2026, and a copy of my letter is attached. He has replied, and his response is also attached. He acknowledges my report, says the matter will be looked at, and proposes a repair by a contractor, with access to the flat on 16 November 2026. The mould has not been fixed so far, and it has continued to spread since my letter. I am not sure whether the proposed work will take place on the date given, and I have not yet received any further details about the contractor or the scope of the work. I would be grateful if you could advise me on my options and on what I should do next, including whether your insurance covers the cost of legal advice on this matter. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Charlie Wade
